title: ModelDocViewStyle description insertion fast slice
scope: Serialize a changed DetailViewStyle model-document description when group 3 is absent from the captured subclass.
Insert in the AcDbModelDocViewStyle subclass using its recognized field order while retaining opaque group relative order.
Verify typed same-version ASCII and Binary readback without adding repository fixtures or CTest registrations.

implementation.behavior: Added a bounded subclass-scoped insertion helper for ModelDocViewStyle fields. Recognized model-document fields are ordered 70, 3, 290, 300, 90; an absent requested code is inserted before the next higher-ranked recognized field, without reordering opaque groups. Raw-value vectors remain aligned for ASCII and Binary carriers.
implementation.generatedControl: The generated secondary DetailViewStyle omits group 3 from its model-document subclass. The test confirms the typed description starts empty, edits it to DOC_DESCRIPTION_2_EDITED, verifies the exact raw sequence, and asserts typed ASCII/Binary readback.

limitations: Only same-version generated DXF insertion of this model-document string field is covered.
Other missing ModelDocViewStyle fields remain fail-closed when edited.
No DWG-origin typed output, cross-version translation, native style rendering, or consumer support qualification follows.
